summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. (Enlight) filed a Form 6-K announcing that an indirect US subsidiary secured $2,622 million in construction financing from a syndicate of banks (Wells Fargo, BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole, Natixis, NordLB, SocGen, MUFG) for the CO Bar complex in Arizona, which comprises five solar/storage projects totaling 1.2 GW solar and 4.0 GWh storage. The debt converts to term loans at COD, with a 5.9% all-in interest rate and mini-perm structures. This is an ordinary project financing event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category applies.
